data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for video compression on Android, iOS, and macOS.
data.what_it_does: Generates a compressed MP4 video with modified width, height, and bitrate from a source video path, reducing high bitrates while maintaining good quality. It provides progress updates via a stream and allows compression cancellation.
use_when: You need to compress video files before uploading them in your Flutter app.
You want to target Android, iOS, and macOS platforms with video optimization.
avoid_when: You need complex video editing features beyond compression, scaling, and bitrate modification.
strengths: Supports multiple video qualities (very_low to very_high).
Provides compression progress updates via a stream.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration for permissions on Android and iOS.
Requires specific build.gradle configurations and minimum Kotlin version on Android.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription in iOS Info.plist, storage/media permissions in AndroidManifest.xml, and JitPack repository along with Kotlin version updates in Android build.gradle files.
data.minimal_example:
final LightCompressor _lightCompressor = LightCompressor();
final Result response = await _lightCompressor.compressVideo(
  path: _sourcePath,
  destinationPath: _destinationPath,
  videoQuality: VideoQuality.medium,
  isMinBitrateCheckEnabled: false,
  video: Video(videoName: videoName),
  android: AndroidConfig(isSharedStorage: true, saveAt: SaveAt.Movies),
  ios: IOSConfig(saveInGallery: true),);
